title: Loop+ Tenure Goodwill Credit: Marketplace Orders Guarantee Grants
content:
**Table rule.** The Loop+ tenure credit of the Marketplace Orders guarantee grant counts the membership fee charges on the buyer's Loop+ ledger, each charge counting when the whole calendar months from its charge date to the decision date are fewer than the tenure window of 36 months: at least the long-tenure count of 24 charges earns the long-tenure credit of USD 6.00; at least the short-tenure count of 12 but fewer than 24 earns the short-tenure credit of USD 3.00; fewer earn no tenure credit.

Each goodwill credit of the guarantee grant is decided on its own; it is added together with any other goodwill credit of the grant, and what is paid of the credits is added to the amount claimed.

The entries counted are membership fee charges on the buyer's Loop+ Membership ledger.

| Fee charges counted (fewer than 36 whole months before the decision date) | Credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 6.00 |
| 12 to 23 | 3.00 |
| 0 to 11 | 0.00 |

## Hypothetical cases

1. A buyer on a monthly plan with 30 fee charges, of which 26 fall fewer than 36 whole months before the decision date: 26 count, USD 6.00.
2. A buyer on an annual plan with 3 fee charges in the window: 3 count, nothing.
3. A charge dated 35 whole months and some days before the decision date counts; one dated 36 whole months before does not.
